startfile.description: The initial URL or local file to load when Lynx starts.

homepage.description: A separate homepage URL, distinct from the startfile.

display_charset.description: The MIME name of the character set for terminal output.

assume_charset.description: The MIME name of the character set for documents that do not specify one.

organization.description: The string used in the Organization: header for USENET news postings.

nntpserver.description: The default NNTP server used for USENET news reading and posting.

mail_inbox.description: The default inbox Lynx will check for new mail.

timeout_seconds.description: Sets the connection timeout in seconds. 0 means no timeout.

dump_width.description: Number of columns for formatting of dumps.
